describe.brief: Deployment view of Production: 7 nodes, 4 hosted elements, 4 communication paths.

sections.heading: Nodes
items: Student's computer (device)
Web browser (environment, Chrome, Firefox, or Safari), inside Student's computer; hosts Planner Web App
Campus cloud (environment, Kubernetes)
Ingress load balancer (infrastructure, NGINX), inside Campus cloud
API pod ×3 (environment, Kubernetes pod), inside Campus cloud; hosts Registration API
Managed database (environment, PostgreSQL 16), inside Campus cloud; hosts Registration Database
University data center (environment); hosts Billing System

sections.heading: Communication paths
items: Registration API writes seat holds to Registration Database using SQL/TCP.
Registration API requests tuition charges from Billing System using AMQP (asynchronous).
Web browser sends HTTPS requests to Ingress load balancer.
Ingress load balancer forwards HTTPS requests to API pod.

describe.brief: Deployment view of Production: 7 nodes, 3 hosted elements, 3 communication paths.

sections.heading: Nodes
items: Student's computer (device)
Web browser (environment, Chrome, Firefox, or Safari), inside Student's computer; hosts Planner Web App
Campus cloud (environment, Kubernetes)
Ingress load balancer (infrastructure, NGINX), inside Campus cloud
API pod ×3 (environment, Kubernetes pod), inside Campus cloud; hosts Registration API
Managed database (environment, PostgreSQL 16), inside Campus cloud; hosts Registration Database
University data center (environment)

sections.heading: Communication paths
items: Registration API writes seat holds to Registration Database using SQL/TCP.
Web browser sends HTTPS requests to Ingress load balancer.
Ingress load balancer forwards HTTPS requests to API pod.
